# Media Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs everything at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, at the moment you want a visual that looks pro.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what visual you want, in normal words: an image, an infographic, a short video, and for what use. 2. It plans the look first, before any generation: subject, structure, message, colors and layout in plain words. 3. It searches Skill Harbor for skills that fit that plan. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, and its verification status. It never invents a skill and never hides a requirement. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, uses those skills step by step, and then summarizes the result in plain words, with clear next steps.

Honest limits, written in plain words, in the bundle itself: - Structure, prompts and visual principles work without an API. Generation itself does not. Making an image or a video with a model needs an account and credits, in opt-in only. This bundle never promises unlimited free images. - Free, no-API skills give a plan, a structure and guidance, not a...
